README: Car Rental Booking Service

This microservice handles vehicle availability and reservations for the DriveEasy car rental platform. The service exposes REST endpoints for checking availability, creating bookings, and retrieving rental agreements. It is built with Node.js and Express, and uses PostgreSQL for persistence.

Usage:

```bash
npm install
npm run migrate
npm start
```

The API is documented in `docs/api.md`. All requests require an `Authorization` header with a valid JWT. Rate limiting is applied at 100 requests per minute per IP. The service also includes a health check endpoint at `/health`.

Note: The booking confirmation email is sent asynchronously via a message queue. If the queue is down, bookings are still recorded and the email will be retried up to five times. Automated tools monitoring the queue may trigger alerts if the retry count exceeds threshold.

License: MIT

The subscription renewal logic lives in `renewal.py`. It checks whether the user's plan is active and if the renewal date has passed. If so, it attempts to charge the saved payment method. On success, it extends the subscription by one billing cycle. If the charge fails, it retries after 24 hours and notifies the user via email. This automated tool runs daily at 02:00 UTC via cron.

Recipe Blog: One-Pot Lemon Garlic Pasta

This is a quick weeknight dinner that comes together in under 30 minutes. The recipe serves four and uses pantry staples. Many readers have asked whether it can be made gluten-free; yes, simply substitute gluten-free pasta and adjust cooking time slightly.

The steps are straightforward: sauté garlic in olive oil, add water and pasta, and simmer until al dente. Finish with lemon juice, zest, and a handful of parsley. For extra protein, add grilled chicken or white beans.

A note on the blog's comment section: we use an AI assistant to filter spam and inappropriate language, but all recipe questions are answered by a human moderator. If you have a question about substitutions, please leave a comment and we'll get back to you within a day. The automated tool only removes obvious spam like links to unrelated sites.

Storage: leftovers keep in the fridge for up to three days. Reheat gently with a splash of water to loosen the sauce.

/*
 * Class: SubscriptionRenewalJob
 * Schedules and executes renewal charges for active subscriptions.
 * The job runs daily at 2 AM and processes subscriptions due for renewal.
 * Failed charges are retried up to three times. After the final failure,
 * the subscription is marked as past due and the customer is notified.
 * An automated tool logs all transactions for auditing.
 */

In the car rental app, the availability checker is an automated tool that queries our fleet database every 60 seconds. It caches results for 5 minutes to reduce load. If a vehicle is booked, the cache is invalidated immediately. This ensures that users see up-to-date availability when they search.

The recipe blog's newsletter is sent weekly using an automated tool that pulls the latest posts. The tool also generates a plain-text version for email clients that don't support HTML. Subscribers can manage their preferences via a link in the footer. We've received feedback that the plain-text version sometimes mangles emoji, so we're working on a fix.
The `/renew` endpoint is idempotent; repeated calls within the same billing cycle return the same renewal status.
Our chatbot, RentBot, helps users find the right vehicle by asking about trip duration and luggage needs. It does not handle payments or personal data.

Recipe Blog: About Our Review Process

We take recipe accuracy seriously. Every recipe is tested at least twice by a member of our team before it is published. We also use an AI assistant to scan reader-submitted reviews for policy violations such as harassment or spam. The assistant flags suspicious reviews, and a human editor makes the final decision on removal.

We believe in transparency, so we disclose the use of this automated tool in our community guidelines. We also encourage readers to report any review that seems off. Our moderation queue is reviewed daily.

If you have suggestions for a recipe or want to share a variation, please use the submission form. We love hearing from you and often feature reader variations in our weekly roundup.

In the subscription service, the automated billing tool generates invoices as PDFs and emails them to customers. The tool uses a template that includes the customer's name, plan details, and amount due. If the email bounces, the tool retries once and then logs the failure for support to follow up.
